title: About IGCE
text: Indra Ganesan College of Engineering (IGCE) is a premier autonomous institution established in 2008 under the Indra Ganesan Educational & Charitable Trust. It is located at Madurai Main Road (NH-45B), Manikandam, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu 620012. The college is affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, approved by AICTE, and accredited by NAAC with B+ grade. It is also recognized under UGC Section 2(f) & 12(B). The college offers quality technical education with a focus on innovation, industry readiness and ethical values.

title: Contact Information
text: Address: Madurai Main Road (NH-45B), Manikandam, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu 620012. Phone: 0431-3256262 / 0431-2906262. Email: igceprincipal@gmail.com or director@igceng.in. Official website: https://www.igceng.com/. Nearest airport is Tiruchirappalli International Airport (about 5 km away).

title: Undergraduate Courses - B.E / B.Tech
text: IGCE offers 4-year B.E / B.Tech programmes. Branches include: Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, and Agricultural Engineering. Eligibility: 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry/Biology/IT, minimum 45% aggregate (general category). Admission is mainly through TNEA counselling.

title: Postgraduate Courses
text: IGCE offers postgraduate programmes: M.E / M.Tech (2 years) in relevant engineering specializations and MBA (2 years). Eligibility for M.E/M.Tech: Bachelor degree in relevant field with at least 50% marks + CEETA-PG or GATE score. Eligibility for MBA: Graduation with 50% marks + TANCET or other accepted entrance scores. Fees are approximately ₹50,000 for M.E/M.Tech and around ₹30,000–₹35,000 for MBA (indicative, please verify on official site).

title: Fees Structure
text: Approximate fee structure (subject to change, always verify with college): B.E / B.Tech total tuition around ₹2 Lakh for the full course. M.E / M.Tech around ₹50,000. MBA around ₹30,000–₹35,000. Exact current fees, scholarships and payment details should be confirmed from the official website or college office.

title: Placements
text: IGCE provides 100% placement assistance. The college reports a high placement rate (around 95% in recent claims). Students are placed in various Indian companies. Highest package mentioned in public sources is around ₹12 LPA. The college has industry partners and runs skill development labs such as Ifactory Lab (Industry 4.0) and SEED Lab to improve employability.

title: Facilities
text: Campus facilities include Wi-Fi, library, auditorium, computer labs, cafeteria, hostels (separate for boys and girls), transportation, sports facilities (including cricket ground), incubation centre, and Industry 4.0 related labs. The college is committed to providing modern infrastructure for academic and extracurricular growth.

title: Admission Process
text: For B.E/B.Tech: Appear for TNEA, secure a valid rank, then participate in counselling and choose IGCE. For M.E/M.Tech: Qualify GATE or CEETA-PG and apply. For MBA: Qualify TANCET or equivalent and apply. Candidates must meet the minimum eligibility marks. For the latest admission dates, seat matrix and application links, visit the official website igceng.com or contact the college office.
